title: Hearthstone Deck Predictor
shortDescription: A real-time WPF plugin that predicts an opponent's likely Hearthstone deck by combining live card-play events with current Standard meta data.
overview: Hearthstone Deck Predictor is a plugin for Hearthstone Deck Tracker that identifies an opponent's likely deck archetype as a match develops. It combines live game events with current Standard meta deck data from HSReplay.net, progressively narrowing candidate decks as cards are revealed and surfacing likely remaining cards and matchup information to the player.
problem: Hearthstone's meta changes frequently, making it difficult for returning or less experienced players to recognise opposing archetypes and know which threats they should anticipate. Only a small portion of the opponent's deck is visible during a match, so useful predictions need to be derived incrementally from the cards revealed during play.
solution: I built a WPF plugin that integrates with Hearthstone Deck Tracker's internal API and reacts to opponent card-play events in real time. At the beginning of each game, the application retrieves current Standard deck data from HSReplay.net and builds in-memory lookup structures for efficient matching. As cards are revealed, incompatible decks are progressively eliminated and the remaining candidates are ranked to determine the most likely archetype. The interface then presents the predicted deck, likely remaining cards, and matchup information against the player's own likely archetype.
outcome: The application continuously refines its prediction throughout a match, giving players useful context about an opponent's likely strategy and remaining threats while demonstrating real-time event processing, external data integration, and efficient in-memory filtering.
highlights: Integrated with Hearthstone Deck Tracker's internal API to process live game and opponent card-play events
Retrieved current Standard meta deck data from HSReplay.net at the start of each match
Built hash-based in-memory lookup structures for efficient real-time candidate matching
Progressively eliminated incompatible decks and refined archetype predictions as cards were revealed
Surfaced likely remaining cards and matchup information to help players anticipate threats during play
